assessment: Perkaholic 1.07 (2019): its pak stores the table files as ../../../Data/Libs/Tables/rpg/*.tbl, paths that climb out of the pak, with an obsolete .tbl extension. This reads as a packaging mistake of an old mod, not as malware, but path climbing is exactly what the check exists for. Superseded by 85 and 1009 (both downloaded). Quarantined; not needed.

Realistic Horses carries its small data part (4 tables: buff, rpg_param, equippable_item, soul; lower horse and player carrying capacity) plus the complete community cheat-console framework (v1.58, 24 cheat_*.lua, Startup/main.lua, loadstring/loadfile/io.open) and autocheat.lua, which runs cheat_remove_perk and cheat_add_perk at every start. No network or command execution found, but unexpected code that changes player perks. If the data part is wanted, re-pack the *__RH.xml tables without Scripts/.

KCSE plugin (native DLL, built by GitHub Actions per its pdb path): registers the rpg params as console variables; refuses to load on an unknown game build. No suspicious API or URL strings. Native code cannot be verified by reading, so it is held; restore after a Windows Security scan if wanted. Needs KCSE and Address Library.

Permadeath: LightFX64.dll (name of a vendor library, used here as a hook carrier) hooks WHGame.dll (game-over and playline hooks, refuses to patch an unknown build), plus Install-Permadeath.cmd and Uninstall-Permadeath.cmd. Native code and scripts: held.
ASI plugin (MinHook): hooks the repair check and enables a global zero-health repair override. Native code: held. Needs an ASI loader or KCSE.

KcdCombatTune.asi and KCDT.asi: native plugin that exports KCDT_* functions (actor brain, soul skill and stat, defense weights, defense override) and hooks inventory, item transfer and input registration; it is the engine behind the Master Strike and defense tuning. Native code: held.
Ships a .7zip next to the data: the game cannot read .7zip, so which file is the real pak decides whether the mod works at all. Not a security finding.

The extracted folder is an older version of the mod with Data/Tables/rpg/*__perkaholic.xml (no Libs/ root, so not loaded) and a perkaholic.7zip; the .rar is the current version (a ZIP pak with Libs/Tables). Use the .rar.
Two .7zip files (Riposte.7zip, Data/Riposte.7zip): not readable by the game; the working pak is elsewhere in the folder or must be re-packed. Not a security finding.

Ships an installer for engine config (DIY Engine, sys_spec_Physics.cfg: physics cvars) and one Lua script (PickableItem__zzzxdddbrdp.lua) that uses loadstring. Engine-level physics changes, not malware-shaped; worth reading the script before use.

The community Cheat mod itself (framework v1.58, Scripts/Startup/main.lua plus cheat_*.lua): loads code dynamically (loadstring/loadfile) and opens files by design, because it is a console-command framework. Expected for what it is, but it is a script framework with file access: held. The same framework is bundled inside 771, 1193 and 1839.

Hoods Over Helmets (data part: removes kettle helmets from NPCs) bundles the cheat-console Lua framework (cheat_console.lua and others) and a nested .7zip. The framework is not needed for the data part. Held; the table part can be re-packed alone.
Weather Mod ships the cheat-console Lua framework next to its weather files (same payload as 771, 1839). Held.
Let Me Loot: two native files, bin/Win64/dinput8.dll (a loader that hijacks the DirectInput DLL name) and NativeMods/letmeloot.dll. Native code, unverifiable by reading: held.

ReShade package: dxgi.dll is the injector (native). The shaders (.fx) and presets (.ini) are text and were read; their URLs point at the public reshade-shaders repository. The DLL is unverified, so the package is held; the preset text is usable with a ReShade you installed yourself.
ReShade package with a dxgi.dll injector (native, unverified). Held; the preset text remains readable.

ENB/ReShade package for low settings: bin/Win64/dxgi.dll (native, unverified) plus the standard reshade-shaders folder (the .py files are Tobii/FreePIE helper scripts of the Depth3D shader pack, not run by the game; they carry only the shader author's URL). Held.
SLEE/GST ReShade preset package with a dxgi.dll injector (native, unverified) and the standard shader folder (same Depth3D helper .py files as 1403). Held; the preset text remains readable.
Mod Order Tool 1.2: a Windows executable (MOT 1.2 en_US.exe), an external app that edits mod order. Held until the author decides.
Mod Organizer 2 plugin pack (a Python plugin game_kingdomcomedeliverance.py): a script that runs inside Mod Organizer, not in the game. Held (script).
Kingdom Come Script Extender (KCSE): Bin/Win64/dinput8.dll, the native loader that every KCSE plugin needs (2246, 2255, 2270, 2277 and others). Native code: held.
Fast Travel Tweaks: KCSE plugin DLL. Native, needs KCSE and Address Library. Held.
Proper Third Person View: KCD1_TPVCamera.asi (native plugin). Held.
Horse Control Tweaks: KCSE plugin DLL (HorseControl.dll). Native, needs KCSE. Held.
Toggle Hud: KCSE plugin DLL (ToggleHud.dll). Native, needs KCSE. Held.
KCDT: the KCDT.asi plugin (the engine of KcdCombatTune, 2359) in two identical download copies. Native: held.
Faster Book Flipping: FasterBookFlipping.asi (native plugin). Held.
Level content (castle prefabs): the long base64-like strings are encoded object data in prefab XML, not a script. Not a security finding.
Lartigues Upscale Project (texture upscale): ships Data/GameData.7zip, which the game cannot read, next to the real data. Not a security finding.
Fan quest mod (Heritage): a Lua script in the cinematic trigger loads code with loadstring, and a test csv names CScript; both look like vanilla-style quest scaffolding. Read the script before use.
Ships Data/IntimidationStat.7zip, which the game cannot read. Not a security finding.
Auto Hide HUD Reborn: RHUD.lua uses the Lua debug library (debug.*). Common in HUD scripts for introspection; read before use.
ReShade preset pack: contains nested .zip files of shader versions (BloomSat v1.0 and v1.1). Not readable by the game; harmless as data.
A Real Sorted Inventory: one Lua script uses loadstring (UI mod). Read before use.
